en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1424 - Do not neglect to recite

in seven positions: in the first two Rak'ahs of the Night Prayer, in the two Rak'ahs before Fajr, in the two Rak'ahs of Dhuha (mid-morning), in the two Rak'ahs after Maghrib, in the two Rak'ahs of Tawaf (circumambulation), in the two Rak'ahs of Ihram (intention for Hajj or Umrah), and at Fajr when you begin the day with them.
